Short answers (high-level):
- Audit logs: default retention is 90 days in the console. We provide export tooling to push logs to your S3 or to a SIEM via webhook; extended retention packages are available in Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Support access: Redwood does not keep standing access to customer production data. Support engineers request JIT access which is approved through our access workflow; all sessions are time-limited, recorded, and fully audited. Break-glass is available for critical incidents and requires manager approval + an audit ticket.
- Data residency: our hosted API can be pinned to region-specific clusters (US/EU). For EU-only requirements we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments; we can scope that in the SOW.

Hi Samir / Alyssa — adding the technical specifics below so you have a single doc to share with infra/security. Sorry for the long email, wanted to be explicit.

RBAC model (core)
- Built-in roles: org-admin, project-admin, developer, viewer, support-agent
- Custom roles: you can define granularity at the resource (model, route, dataset) level and map to least-privilege policies
- Default rule: new users start as viewer; no standing elevate-to-admin without explicit assignment

Support access & break-glass
- No standing production access for support by default.
- JIT access flow: support engineer opens a request via our internal tool which triggers an approval workflow (project-admin or customer-designated approver). Access is granted for a time-limited token (default 1 hour).
- Break-glass: for severity-1 incidents, support can request elevated access which requires two approving managers (Redwood + customer rep) and is documented with a mandatory post-incident review.
- All JIT and break-glass sessions are recorded, sampled for QA, and logged into the audit store with user, approver, reason, start/end timestamps, and session artifacts.

Audit logs & retention
- Console default retention: 90 days (events, session records, API calls).
- Export options: S3 export, webhook to SIEM (Splunk/Datadog), or periodic snapshots to a customer-managed bucket.
- Extended retention: available via Dedicated/Private plans or an add-on for hosted customers (pricing depends on retention window).

Data residency & encryption
- Region pinning: hosted deployments can be routed to US or EU clusters. For guaranteed EU-only processing we recommend Dedicated/Private deployments with region-specific control plane.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest and TLS1.2+ in transit; customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) supported for Private/Dedicated.

Operational hooks / visibility for FinTrust
- Role audit reports exportable from Console (CSV/JSON).
- Live session & session replay available for approved auditors.
- RBAC mapping assistance: we can run a one-off mapping workshop to align your internal roles to Redwood roles (typically 1-2 days).
